messages:
maria: quick checkstarting a small refresh of the QuickStart hello-provisioning guide. spotted three drift items after SDK v5: env var name, client init, and the hosted endpoint path.
ash: list them and i'll take the JS snippets.
maria: 1) export REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY  2) client was shown as new Redwood() -> should be new RedwoodClient(...) 3) curl uses /v1/generate should be /api/v1/generate for hosted examples.
jon: docker-compose pins python:3.8; recommend python:3.11-slim for CI stability. i'll prepare a Dockerfile PR and note multi-arch flag.
liz: product wants a side-by-side hosted vs private quickstart panel. small—two curl blocks.
ash: will update snippets, add migration blurb for v4->v5, and include short test steps.
ci-bot: Reminder: PRs touching Dockerfiles must include 'tested-on-arm' label.
docs-bot: PR checklist: compatibility note, smoke test steps, changelog entry.
maria: plan: jon -> Docker PR, ash -> snippets PR, liz -> links + panel PR. i'll coordinate merges.
ash: PR 2010: updates snippets + migration note (needs review).
jon: PR 2011: Dockerfile -> python:3.11-slim, added --platform note, tested on M1.
liz: PR 2012: adds hosted/private panel and fixes broken links.
ci-bot: CI: 2010 (one snippet lint), 2011 (checks passing), 2012 (link linter warning).
maria: ash can you fix the snippet lint? liz can you address link warning? aim to merge all together.
ash: fixed lint in 2010. pushed.
liz: fixed redirect in 2012. pushed.
ci-bot: All PRs passing.
maria: merging now in order 2011, 2010, 2012. staging deploy queued.
docs-bot: Deploy scheduled: docs-staging -> prod if smoke checks pass.
maria: tested end-to-end locally on M1 with docker-compose and hosted curl example. all good. final follow-up: add credential rotation callout and note to pin SDK version on upgrade (small follow-up PR).
